userIntakeClassification.exactStatement: 三段视频拍摄的是与目标完全相同的产品，仅花纹和纹路不同。视频用于逐帧确认轴心、滑轨、单向推动、最大行程、任意角度旋转和棘轮玩法。
userIntakeClassification.boundary: 颜色、花纹和纹路差异不得被解释为机构差异。

observed: 426 decoded frames show stepped longitudinal opening and successful closure.
M exterior has silver text/motif; its reverse exposes two Torx screws, rails and ball rows.
C has purple exterior/cyan-doodle reverse and is thumb-driven.
Maximum visible travel is 0.38±0.04L with about 0.62L residual overlap.
Closed stop blocks farther opening in the opposite direction; open-to-closed return succeeds.
Mid-travel relative yaw spans about 11.3°; full rotation is not proven here.
IMG_6022.inferred: Lower-carrier pin plus cover slot is mildly favored, but reciprocal ownership fits nearly as well.

observed: 480 decoded frames show stepped 0°→180°→0° rotation at one translational registration.
The apparent end-to-end pose is rotation rather than translation.
The distal perforation on M is not the pivot.
IMG_6023.inferred: 15 candidate detent impulses per 180° direction support 12° cadence and 30 detents per 360°.
IMG_6023.confidence: strong for cadence; hidden pin not visible

observed: 821 decoded frames expose the M track face around f183–207.
Slide and rotation occur at partial and near-maximum translation.
Maximum travel is about 0.44L median, about 0.50L peak; fitted point/path interval is about 0.46L.
The final about 34° turn has three strong impulses, about 11.3° per impulse.
Reverse slide succeeds; no mechanical jam is demonstrated.
IMG_6024.inferred: A 48-frame fit supports an M fixed point near normalized (u,v)≈(0.36±0.08,0.45±0.10), with C centerline contact traversing u≈0.30–0.76.
IMG_6024.confidence: medium; shaft and slot walls remain hidden

combinedClaims.statement: Two plates are constrained by a compound axis/longitudinal-track relationship.
M is hand-supported and likely carries the fixed point; C is the moving cover.
combinedClaims.unknown: Hidden attachment geometry is not directly visible.

combinedClaims.statement: C carries or follows a centerline longitudinal slot/contact path.
combinedClaims.unknown: Exact concealed slot profile and coupling.

combinedClaims.statement: From closed, slide opens in one outward direction and returns on the same path; it does not pass beyond the closed stop.
Supported travel is about 0.38–0.46L, up to about 0.50L peak.
combinedClaims.boundary: 21 mm is only consistent with this range, not newly measured.

combinedClaims.statement: Detented rotation is strongly supported at 12° per position, 30 per 360°.
combinedClaims.boundary: Videos directly show reversible 0↔180° and up to about 170°; full 360° is user-authoritative.

combinedClaims.statement: Rotation is observed at partial and near-maximum slide.
combinedClaims.unknown: Access at every exact slot location.

combinedClaims.statement: No jam is proven; dwell/release behavior is consistent with detent/breakaway resistance.
Rails, screws and ball rows belong to the exposed reverse/internal face of M, distinct from its normal clean exterior face.
combinedClaims.unknown: Any remaining conflict with prior concealed-overlap interpretation requires user review.
